Package io.telekom.orchest.adapter.kafka

Class WorkerEventConsumerLoader

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.adapter.kafka.WorkerEventConsumerLoader
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.context.Lifecycle, org.springframework.context.Phased, org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
public class WorkerEventConsumerLoader extends Object implements org.springframework.context.SmartLifecycle
Loads and registers Kafka consumers for WorkerEventRequest from consumer.json configuration. Each consumer uses IWorkerEventEventHandler as the handler.

Can be triggered from any module by injecting this bean and calling loadConsumers(). Consumers are automatically registered on context startup when the event handler is available. Implements SmartLifecycle for graceful shutdown.

Consumer loading runs asynchronously to avoid blocking application startup and health probes.

    • loadConsumers

      public boolean loadConsumers()
      Loads consumers from the specified config resource and registers them. Uses a single AdminClient to verify/create all topics in batch, then registers all consumers.
      Returns:
      true if consumers were loaded successfully, false if handler is not available or config is empty.
